## Roll Call

- A. Mortell calls roll. 6/7 voting members present, committee has quorum.

## Review and Adopt Agenda

Committee reviews agenda.

## Motion:

- Larry Marx motions to adopt the agenda.
- Jamie Alley seconds motion.
- All members present voted in favor; none abstained; motion passed.

## Review and Approve Draft Minutes

Committee reviews minutes. Chair Terranova asks for a motion to approve draft minutes with amendment to change 'legal counsel with meet with' to 'legal counsel will meet with' under the Legislative Update.

## Motion:

- Paula Martinez motions to approve draft minutes as amended from 2/11/26.
- Larry Marx seconds motion.
- All members present voted in favor; none abstained; motion passed.

## Authorization to Move to Closed Session

- Compact interim legal counsel N. Kalfas certifies the committee is authorized to move into closed session to discuss confidential and proprietary information from vendors, pursuant to PA Compact Sec. 7.D.3.d, f, and j.

## Vote to Move to Closed Session

- Chair Terranova asks for a motion to move to a closed session.

## Motion:

- Larry Marx motions to move to closed session.
- Marisa Courtney seconds motion.
- All members present voted in favor; none abstained; motion passed.

## Closed Session -Discussion of Data System Vendors

## End Closed Session

Chair Terranova asks for a motion to end closed session.

## Motion:

- Marisa Courtney to end closed session.
- Jamie Alley seconds motion.
- All members present voted in favor; none abstained; motion passed.

## Vote on Data System Vendor Proposals

Chair Terranova asks for a motion to accept the proposal from Focus as data system vendor pending a contractual agreement.

## Motion:

- Larry Marx motions to accept Focus's proposal and authorize Commission Chair to enter contract negotiations with data system vendor.
- Marisa Courtney seconds motion.
- Chair Terranova notes that Focus's experience, staffing approach, and timeline in their proposal all met the expectations outlined in the RFP.
- All members present voted in favor; none abstained; motion passed.

## Delegate and Public Questions and Comments

- K. Scarbalis thanks committee for thoughtful discussion on choosing a data system vendor.
- J. Alley thanks Commission staff for the support in the data system procurement process.

## Public Questions and Comments

- None.

## Adjourn

Hearing no further business or discussion, Chair Terranova adjourned the meeting at 3:40 p.m. ET.
